REALM_TOKEN.description: Shared bearer token used by Hysteria realm servers and clients. Generate a long random value.

ABLY_API_KEY.description: Full Ably API key with publish and subscribe permissions. Keep it in Worker secrets.

METRICS_TOKEN.description: Optional separate Bearer token that enables GET /metrics.

REALM_NAME_PATTERN.description: Optional JavaScript realm-name regular expression; defaults to the Hy2 Realm pattern.

MAX_REALMS.description: Maximum active realms. Set to 0 for unlimited; defaults to 65536.

MAX_REALMS_PER_IP.description: Maximum active realms registered by one client IP. Set to 0 for unlimited; defaults to 4.

TRUSTED_PROXY_HEADER.description: Trusted client IP header. Defaults to CF-Connecting-IP; only use a header overwritten by your proxy.

DEBUG.description: Set to true only while troubleshooting.
